updates.title: Update from Git
updates.description: Check an official source revision, then explicitly approve its installation. The host updater handles builds, backups and recovery.
updates.disabled: The host updater is not configured. An operator must connect the updater service before updates can be installed here.
updates.refHelp: Checking does not install an update. Select main explicitly to use the latest development revision.
updates.applyHelp: Installation may temporarily interrupt access. The updater will stop writers and create a backup before migration.
updates.confirmCommit: Type the full candidate commit to approve installation
updates.recoveryHelp: This update needs recovery. Do not restart an older version against a database that may have been migrated.
updates.confirmRecovery: Type the operation ID to approve recovery
updates.operatorRecovery: Recovery is not available through this page. Contact the installation operator.
updates.runningHelp: The update continues on the host even if this page closes. Access may be temporarily unavailable; only status requests are retried.
updates.pollPaused: Automatic status checks have paused. Refresh status to continue monitoring.
updates.reconcile: The command result is uncertain. Checking status before allowing another action; the command will not be sent again automatically.
updates.unavailable: Updater status is unavailable. Refresh status after the application or host service becomes available.
updates.uncertain: The command acknowledgement was not received. Check status before trying another action.
calendar.provisionalNotice: Years {{years}} use a provisional Monday–Friday schedule. Holidays and transferred working days are not yet verified.
calendar.annualHelp: Choose a fixed calendar version for each available year. Unselected years use provisional weekdays; importing a calendar does not select it automatically.
calendar.anchorHelp: This year comes from the project’s primary calendar. Choose another verified version to replace it.
calendar.replacementPreview: Calendar changes open a date preview. Review and explicitly apply the changes before saving.
calendar.budgetExceeded: The schedule exceeds its calculation or result-size budget. Reduce the amount of scheduled work or split the project, then try again. No partial schedule was saved.
